description:
Fire-Boltt Almighty 1.39" AMOLED smartwatch with Bluetooth calling is built for people who want a premium round dial, sharp 454×454 display, and long battery life in one everyday watch. The vivid AMOLED screen looks crisp indoors and outdoors, making caller ID, notifications, and watch faces easy to read at a glance. Take calls from your wrist using the built-in speaker and microphone—perfect when your phone is charging, in your bag, or you’re on the move.

Track your day with 360° health monitoring features like SpO2, heart rate, blood pressure and sleep tracking, plus multiple sports modes for workouts and walks. Use the voice assistant for quick hands-free actions, control music, and trigger your phone camera remotely for group shots. With a durable zinc alloy body, comfortable black leather strap, IP67 splash resistance, and up to 10 days battery in normal use, Almighty is a smart pick for office wear, travel, and daily fitness—without the nightly charging stress.

features: 1.39" AMOLED 454×454 display: Crisp, high-density screen with deep blacks for clear text, smooth watch faces and easy outdoor readability.
Bluetooth calling (speaker + mic): Answer and talk from your wrist when paired to your phone—handy for commutes, cooking, and quick work calls.
Voice assistant support: Trigger your phone’s assistant for hands-free tasks like calling contacts and setting reminders (depends on phone/app permissions).
360° health tracking suite: SpO2, heart rate, blood pressure and sleep tracking to help you stay aware of daily trends (not a medical device).
Multiple sports modes: Track common workouts and daily activities to stay consistent and motivated.
Up to 10-day battery life: Designed to last through the week on normal use; less time charging, more time wearing.
IP67 splash & sweat resistance: Suitable for daily wear, gym sweat and light rain (not for swimming or hot showers).
Music and camera control: Control playback and use remote camera shutter for selfies and group photos.
Premium build feel: Zinc alloy dial with a comfortable black leather strap for a dressy, everyday look.
Smart notifications: Call, message and app alerts on the wrist so you stay updated without checking your phone constantly.
